messages.content:
You map steps of a user scenario in the Train Ticket web application to backend REST requests.
Train Ticket is a set of Java microservices behind a gateway (/api/v1/<service>/...). A browser UI (ts-ui-dashboard) sends the requests.

Rules:
- Every scenario step sends exactly one HTTP request through the gateway. Pick the one backend handler that serves it, even when the web UI would send several requests or none for that action.
- Services come in twins for the two train kinds: high-speed trains (GaoTie/DongChe, trip numbers starting with G or D) and regular trains (the 'Other' type, e.g. K, T, Z). The twin with 'other' or '2' in its service name (ts-travel2-service, ts-order-other-service, ts-preserve-other-service) serves regular trains; the plain one serves high-speed trains. Choose the twin by the train kind of the trip or order the step works with.
- When a UI variant is sent only under a condition, check the condition against the scenario.
- Prefer a handler that the web UI calls for this kind of action (candidates show their UI page and action). Handlers without UI are mostly internal APIs that other services call; choose one only when no UI handler does what the step asks.
- Administrator steps (admin console) use admin services; passenger steps do not.
- A step that the system refuses still sends its request: pick the handler that refuses it.

Enum codes used in request fields:
- AssuranceType: TRAFFIC_ACCIDENT=1 (Traffic Accident Assurance, 3.0)
- DocumentType: NONE=0 (Null), ID_CARD=1 (ID Card), PASSPORT=2 (Passport), OTHER=3 (Other)
- Gender: NONE=0 (Null), MALE=1 (Male), FEMALE=2 (Female), OTHER=3 (Other)
- MoneyType: A=Add Money (1), D=Draw Back Money (2)
- OrderStatus: NOTPAID=0 (Not Paid), PAID=1 (Paid & Not Collected), COLLECTED=2 (Collected), CHANGE=3 (Cancel & Rebook), CANCEL=4 (Cancel), REFUNDS=5 (Refunded), USED=6 (Used)
- PaymentType: P=Payment (1), D=Difference (2), O=Outside Payment (3), E=Difference & Outside Payment (4)
- SeatClass: NONE=0 (NoSeat), BUSINESS=1 (GreenSeat), FIRSTCLASS=2 (FirstClassSeat), SECONDCLASS=3 (SecondClassSeat), HARDSEAT=4 (HardSeat), SOFTSEAT=5 (SoftSeat), HARDBED=6 (HardBed), SOFTBED=7 (SoftBed), HIGHSOFTBED=8 (HighSoftSeat)
- Type: G=G (1), D=D (2), Z=Z (3), T=T (4), K=K (5)
- WaitListOrderStatus: NOTPAID=0 (Not Paid), PAID=1 (Paid & Not Collected), COLLECTED=2 (Collected), CANCEL=3 (Cancel), REFUNDS=4 (Refunded), EXPIRED=5 (Expired)

Scenario S0: My account: contacts, orders of both train types, paid orders, luggage consignments
Description: A registered passenger logs in and opens their contact book. They refresh their list of orders twice — for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains and for regular ('Other' type) trains, which are kept separately — and then refresh the orders once more with the filter 'Paid' status. Finally they look up the luggage consignments registered on their account. Nothing is searched, booked or paid.
Steps:
1. Log in with username and password
2. Open the contact book
3. Refresh the list of orders for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains
4. Refresh the list of orders for regular ('Other' type) trains
5. Refresh the list of orders filtered by the 'Paid' status
6. Look up the luggage consignments registered on the account

Requests of earlier steps:
step 1: POST /api/v1/users/login -> UserController#getToken [ts-auth-service] (success)

Current step 2: Open the contact book

Candidate handlers:
C1: GET /api/v1/contactservice/contacts/account/{accountId}
    handler ContactsController#findContactsByAccountId(String accountId) in ts-contacts-service
    UI: page client_ticket_book, action refresh_booking_contacts ["Refresh Contacts"]
    UI: page admin, admin_config, admin_contacts, admin_price, admin_station, admin_train, action getContactOptions
    code: ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[findContactsByAccountId][Find Contacts By Account Id][accountId: {}]", accountId); ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[ContactsService][VerifyLogin Success]"); return ok(contactsService.findContactsByAccountId(accountId, headers));
C2: GET /api/v1/contactservice/contacts/{id}
    handler ContactsController#getContactsByContactsId(String id) in ts-contacts-service
    UI: none (the web UI never calls it)
    code: ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[ContactsService][Contacts Id Print][id: {}]", id); ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[ContactsService][VerifyLogin Success]"); return ok(contactsService.findContactsById(id, headers));
C3: GET /api/v1/adminbasicservice/adminbasic/contacts
    handler AdminBasicInfoController#getAllContacts() in ts-admin-basic-info-service
    UI: page admin_contacts, action controller:contactCtrl
    code: AdminBasicInfoController.LOGGER.info("[getAllContacts][Find All Contacts by admin][getAllContacts] "); return ok(adminBasicInfoService.getAllContacts(headers));
C4: POST /api/v1/contactservice/contacts
    handler ContactsController#createNewContacts(Contacts aci) in ts-contacts-service
    body: id, accountId, name, documentType, documentNumber, phoneNumber
    UI: page client_ticket_book, action preserveCreateNewContacts ["Select"]
    code: ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[createNewContacts][VerifyLogin Success]"); return new ResponseEntity<>(contactsService.create(aci, headers), HttpStatus.CREATED);
C5: GET /api/v1/contactservice/contacts
    handler ContactsController#getAllContacts() in ts-contacts-service
    UI: none (the web UI never calls it)
    code: ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[getAllContacts][Get All Contacts]"); return ok(contactsService.getAllContacts(headers));
C6: POST /api/v1/preserveotherservice/preserveOther
    handler PreserveOtherController#preserve(OrderTicketsInfo oti) in ts-preserve-other-service
    serves regular trains (the 'Other' type, not G/D) only; its twin serves the other kind
    body: accountId, contactsId, tripId, seatType, loginToken, date, from, to, assurance, foodType, stationName, storeName, foodName, foodPrice, handleDate, consigneeName, consigneePhone, consigneeWeight, isWithin
    UI: page client_ticket_book, action click:#ticket_select_contacts_confirm_btn ["Select"]; sent only when: selectContactsStatus == true && !(tripType == 'G' || tripType == 'D'); the same UI action also sends: POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve (when selectContactsStatus == true && tripType == 'G' || tripType == 'D')
    code: PreserveOtherController.LOGGER.info("[preserve][Preserve Account order][from {} to {} at {}]", oti.getFrom(), oti.getTo(), oti.getDate()); return ok(preserveService.preserve(oti, headers));
C7: POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve
    handler PreserveController#preserve(OrderTicketsInfo oti) in ts-preserve-service
    serves high-speed trains (GaoTie/DongChe, G/D) only; its twin serves the other kind
    body: accountId, contactsId, tripId, seatType, loginToken, date, from, to, assurance, foodType, stationName, storeName, foodName, foodPrice, handleDate, consigneeName, consigneePhone, consigneeWeight, isWithin
    UI: page client_ticket_book, action click:#ticket_select_contacts_confirm_btn ["Select"]; sent only when: selectContactsStatus == true && tripType == 'G' || tripType == 'D'; the same UI action also sends: POST /api/v1/preserveotherservice/preserveOther (when selectContactsStatus == true && !(tripType == 'G' || tripType == 'D'))
    code: PreserveController.LOGGER.info("[preserve][Preserve Account order][from {} to {} at {}]", oti.getFrom(), oti.getTo(), oti.getDate()); return ok(preserveService.preserve(oti, headers));
C8: GET /api/v1/contactservice/contacts/welcome
    handler ContactsController#home() in ts-contacts-service
    UI: none (the web UI never calls it)
    code: return "Welcome to [ Contacts Service ] !";
C9: POST /api/v1/adminbasicservice/adminbasic/contacts
    handler AdminBasicInfoController#addContacts(Contacts c) in ts-admin-basic-info-service
    body: id, accountId, name, documentType, documentNumber, phoneNumber
    UI: page admin_contacts, action addContact ["Add"]; sent only when: parseInt($('#add-contact-document-type').val())
    code: AdminBasicInfoController.LOGGER.info("[addContacts][Modify Contacts by admin][Contacts name: {}]", c.getName()); return ok(adminBasicInfoService.addContact(c, headers));
C10: PUT /api/v1/contactservice/contacts
    handler ContactsController#modifyContacts(Contacts info) in ts-contacts-service
    body: id, accountId, name, documentType, documentNumber, phoneNumber
    UI: none (the web UI never calls it)
    code: ContactsController.LOGGER.info("[Contacts modifyContacts][Modify Contacts] ContactsId: {}", info.getId()); return ok(contactsService.modify(info, headers));

Answer with JSON: a short reasoning (one or two sentences), the candidate label, whether the system serves the step ('success') or refuses it ('refused', only if the step says so), and refs — which results of earlier steps this request uses (e.g. "trip": "first_of_step_2" for the first trip found at step 2, "order": "new_of_step_6" for the order created at step 6). Leave refs empty when the request uses nothing from earlier steps.

response.reasoning: The user opens their contact book, which corresponds to retrieving the list of contacts for the logged-in account. Candidate C1 matches this action exactly, serving the 'refresh_booking_contacts' UI action for the client ticket book page.
